scope.summary: Implement the asset-browser surface that lists local and enabled-library components with text search, section grouping by library and by document page, and drag-to-insert (operator) / typed-insert (model, MT-324) instantiation. Component and style organization uses slash-path names (e.g. Button/Primary/Large) that render as nested picker folders; the slash-path is a naming convention on the name, not a distinct folder entity.
acceptance_criteria: Asset browser lists local+library components with search/grouping/drag-insert
expected_tests: argus: asset browser reachable with stable author_ids; text search + library/page grouping + drag-insert
test: slash-path names render as nested folders without a folder entity; typed-insert parity with drag-insert
acceptance_criteria_original: asset browser lists local+library components with search/grouping/drag-insert; slash-path folders; author_ids + manual entry

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: [STU-DS-005] Studio MUST provide an asset-browser surface that lists local and enabled-library components with text search, section grouping by library and by document page, and drag-to-insert (operator) / typed-insert (model) instantiation.

[STU-DS-005a] Component and style organization uses slash-path names (e.g. `Button/Primary/Large`) that render as nested picker folders without a separate folder entity; the slash-path is a naming convention on the component/style name, not a distinct primitive. ### 2. Variants and Variant Properties Variants let one component carry many named states (size, style, state) without duplicating definitions, and are the backing for runtime variant switching and interactive components in 14.11.

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.

resource_privacy_obligation.rule: Resources this contract reads, derives, caches or exports stay inside the authenticated operator's scope. No cross-identity read path may be introduced.

patch_provenance.preserved: The original acceptance prose is kept verbatim at scope.acceptance_criteria_original. No clause, scope decision, path list or obligation from the original contract was removed.
